notes.title: 🚨 Supercar Collection Simulator 1.0 – Full Release Out Now! 🚨
notes.notes:
Dear Collectors, the wait is over.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/bcf9b66e5b533dc5b20add7d8537f80de48590bb.png"]

Supercar Collection Simulator 1.0 is now fully released after early access!

Do you remember the excitement of discovering your first supercar?

From that moment until now, every car that captivated you and every race you've won has made this world grow even more. Now, more cars, more races, and more strategy await you!

Have You Seen the Full Release Trailer? 🎥 
[previewyoutube="vqDpo8Xvp1E;full"][/previewyoutube]

Explore the 1.0 Full Release Features:

Black Market – Full of Secrets 🚐
The Black Market will appear in the city at certain times. Play a mini guessing game to negotiate the price of rare collectible cars and grab these special cars before the opportunity vanishes.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/3f8a3926f983cb02585fefac2211a50dde5f94ca.gif"]

New Car Series – Expand Your Collection 🚘
Add new cars to your collection. Expand your shelves and join races to hunt down the next "must-have" model.

Betting Tables – Risk & Reward 🎲
Watch your customers race each other and bet on the winner. Win big or lose it all and come up with a new strategy.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/4b76c06d7b9b01972e19b6045f484101582ed2ed.gif"]

Paintable Cars – Customize Your Collection 🎨
With new paintable cars, you can further personalize your collection. Paint your cars in your favorite colors and create a unique collection that’s all your own.

Showroom Customization – Fresh Look, Fresh Style 🏬
Redesign your garage! Paint the walls and floors to give your showroom a completely new vibe and display your collection in a more stylish way.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/aa766d82f0ba140f4c721fe4fe7966693cfa9b9b.gif"]
Custom Wall Posters – Made by You 🖌️
Design your own posters using stickers, photos, or freehand drawings and show your style to the world. Personalizing your collection has never been more fun!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/b2006bec857f77a0667d1dc37877a7da38e488fd.gif"]


👥 And that’s just launch day.

We can’t wait to see how your feedback continues to shape the experience.


👉 Play now. Expand your collection. The adventure is just getting started!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/58bd0d5ff8eb0ccd34e2c2479845ceedb159c8e8.png"]

notes.title: Supercar Collection Simulator - Full Release on September 8!
notes.notes:
Dear Collectors,

Today, we’re celebrating something huge:


Supercar Collection Simulator is leaving Early Access and officially releasing on September 8! 🎉


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/d678075a057416f53b9b1d11261c821ce8141d99.png"]



To every player who joined us in Early Access, followed every update, and filled their collections with dream cars, race to get them, hunt the hunt house… To our passionate Discord community, whose feedback shaped every feature you see today...
Together, we even hit a record of 1,387 collectors online at the same time. 
And here we are, Supercar Collection Simulator is releasing!



          [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/8659dea5dc5c73770b62cbf5c5613b9a27ebf83a.png"]


🚗 Lets’ Look What We’ve Built in Early Access
Your journey helped us transform SCS into the amazing supercar experience. Here’s everything we’ve added so far:

Master Series & Vintage Series for the rarest rides

Champion Series & Extra Series expansions

Custom car design system with polished painting & stickers, plus custom sticker creation

Cashier, store staff, and warehouse staff systems for a living dealership

Warehouse storage system with auto-closing boxes for easier management

Hunt House for thrilling rare car hunts

Vending Machine, Bundle Table, and Shark Table to boost your store’s business

Twitch integration for live interactive gameplay

New product and furniture varieties to customize your dealership

Store rating system to level up your reputation

New achievements for collectors

Product price statistics for better dealership management

Balanced drop rates, refined UI, and countless bug fixes



            [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/6ead26ae05227fdc7f526bfd07958c54eeaf2031.png"]


🚀Coming Hot! Save The Date - September 8
Full version of Supercar Collection Simulator is THE supercar collection experience, and it brings:

Redesigned store layouts for total creative freedom

The thrilling Black Market

Betting tables to challenge customers in style

A brand-new car series featuring ultra‑rare models

Leaderboards are back — show the world who’s on top!

Custom‑designable posters to turn your store into a showroom masterpiece


Time flies, and here we are: Supercar Collection Simulator releases in Full Version on September 8.


Get ready to build the collection, race with your customers, try multiplayer trade and be the legendary collector.



Mark September 8 on your calendars, that day will be a collection piece!



See you at the Hunt House.



-Kiki Games Team

notes.title: REGULAR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,

Update Notes:

Bugs in the painting system have been fixed.

Issues with texture import and export have been resolved.

The sticker import limit has been increased from 2 MB to 4 MB.

A special button has been added to use the painted vehicle’s image as a sticker (available in the Special Sticker menu). This way, you can use the image of your custom-designed car in car packages.

The Supercar logo can now be used as a sticker.

The limit for custom addable stickers has been increased from 20 to 100.

A button has been added to rename vehicles. Now you can give any name you like to your custom cars.

Open storage boxes will now automatically close when placed on a shelf.

Store statistics application

Profitability mechanics based on store rating

"Hunt House" game is now classified as a daytime activity

Extra series probabilities have been adjusted

The paint and bundle table can now be placed in the storage room.

Item storage boxes can no longer be placed on the storage shelves. These shelves are now exclusively for product storage boxes.

The game will very soon be available in its 1.0 version.
In the full release, all car series and the BlackMarket vendor will be waiting for you!



have fun!









[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/8b03f673c87fe7fac4712c42abc5955e4eab63b5.png"]-SIERRA

notes.title: REGULAR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,
I'm here with a regular update before the next big patch!

I noticed many of you were unhappy with the vending machine area and its pricing. This update includes some adjustments to address that.

Here are the update notes:

3 new challenging and luck-based achievements have been added.

Vending machine probabilities have been rebalanced, and the vending machine price has been updated to $25.

Twitch integration has been added to the game.

A bug where shield and rocket skills caused slowdown effects during NPC races has been fixed.

There was also an issue where cars wouldn't be awarded at the end of races. We made some adjustments to address this, but honestly, we're not entirely sure if the issue is completely resolved, as we haven't been able to reproduce it.
Please let us know if you still encounter this problem.

And finally, a small hint for the future:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/c327d77617a1e259f2ddd622ff1eb2f964701967.png


have fun!








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/8b03f673c87fe7fac4712c42abc5955e4eab63b5.png-SIERRA

notes.title: BUG FIX
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,
Before our next major update, we're releasing a small bug fix patch.
Here are the patch notes:

Fixed an issue where skills behaved incorrectly in NPC races.

Resolved a bug where skill cards were dropping from the wrong packs (Series 1 cards were appearing in Series 2 packs).

Fixed an outline issue on Race Track 02.

Skills no longer travel endlessly until they hit an opponent; they now disappear based on their level, so timing will be more important.

Fixed some rare bugs related to the customer system.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/8b03f673c87fe7fac4712c42abc5955e4eab63b5.png-SIERRA

notes.title: BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
Hello dear players!

Before the next major update, we’ve fixed some bugs and added a few small improvements. Here's what’s included in this mini patch:

🛠️ Patch Notes :

Fixed an issue where customers would freeze while purchasing products.

Cars won from NPC races will now be marked with a “New” tag if they aren’t already in your collection.

Resolved certain freezing issues that occurred during Trade (PvP).

Fixed a bug causing camera drift after exiting NPC races.

Fixed bugs related to the "Speed Up" option in the loot box animation, and improved the performance of Total Value calculations.

Fixed an issue where skill particle effects would disappear during races.

have fun!

notes.title: CASHIER UPDATE
notes.notes:
Cashiers can now be hired!
While you focus on building your car collection and racing, let your employees handle the registers for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/f18096688a72142778f192000ace1c291e5b953b.gif

Hello dear players!
We saw how much you wanted a cashier update, so we worked hard to bring it forward sooner than planned.

We’ve also included many of the community’s suggestions in this update. Here are the patch notes:

Day duration has been extended.

Product profitability has been increased.

The game keeps running while it's in the background (alt-tabbed).

Fixed a bug where customers would constantly bend over when picking up products.

Store upgrade levels have been reduced.

Fixed various screen resolution issues.

Rival NPC car speeds are now hidden, making races more thrilling and risky.

After level 5, you can now skip the animation when opening car packs.

Skill card pack opening speed has been increased.

The "My Collection" app now shows how many cars you own out of the total in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/3c9b44783378ddf33a90bd3a5cfb725e7f213575.png

I also want to give you a little sneak peek about some future updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/5e94f3b733325f7b8ec144435fda39d2ed1ad438.png

:D have fun!
